notes: Read both immigration units, full preceding Postal Service context, all twenty-three candidates and the review. Disposed candidates one through ten because they import Postal Service positions while falsely citing immigration text. Corrected evidence to unit one for the unity, values, safety, economy and reputation claims; retained the desired-approach contrast without inventing a separate failure; named U.S. scope; and limited the nonrecurrence demand to the enumerated immigration actions. Restored the historical unity and immigration account and the callous, cruel, reckless and conscience-shocking evaluations.

claims.claim_text: The idea that many peoples form one nation is characterized as a foundational American principle that inspired global participation in U.S. democracy from the country's earliest days.
Democrats characterize the Trump administration as repudiating that unity principle and abandoning U.S. values of diversity, compassion and welcome.
Democrats characterize the Trump administration's immigration approach as callous, cruel and extremely reckless rather than sensible, humane and responsible.
The Trump administration's immigration policies are said to have made U.S. communities less safe.
The Trump administration's immigration policies are said to have harmed the U.S. economy.
The Trump administration's immigration policies are said to have damaged the United States' global image.
Democrats characterize the administration's enumerated treatment of immigrants as cruel, dehumanizing and conscience-shocking.
The Trump administration is said to have conducted militarized raids on U.S. workplaces.
The enumerated family separations, child detention, veteran deportations, raids, care denials, travel bans and refugee rejections should not recur in the United States.
